item.description:
First public release of Drop — a fast, native macOS app for downloading and converting online video and audio using yt-dlp and ffmpeg.
Features: - Paste-and-go downloading with automatic link analysis - Quality selection up to 4K, MP4/MKV output, audio-only extraction - Smart MP4 codec compatibility (avoids VP9/AV1-in-MP4 playback failures) - Menu bar quick paste - Download history with one-click redownload/retry - Self-updating bundled yt-dlp/ffmpeg - In-app self-update via this Releases page
